svg.text: Inference step 1: first pass with a placeholder workflow slot
Prefix frames are encoded visually; the placeholder cluster token is present for HTA, but the phase head is decoupled from it.
Concrete MB140 / BBP12 prefix ending at the current timestamp t. Only observed frames are shown here.
Dummy token lets HTA run before the prefix-derived soft token exists.
phase head reads visual features only
Key point: the placeholder runs HTA only. Phase logits come from the visual prefix and are used next to infer the soft workflow token.
